body_html:
My fitness plan
#smallpoems

Live your happy. Nothing
matters.
find your happy
in all that
matters,
of food
eat closest to
the sun,
no dogma
honest fun.
Just math.
Do push ups
go outside.
paying to run
in place, lift heavy stuff,
just dumb
you are your
resistance
weight,
unless that
your happy place.
fitness
has so little to
do with
physical
No matter
matters
more than
matters
of physical
states that
do not matter.
